package onboardingcontract

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	studentuc "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/student"
)

const (
	DraftReplaceBodyLimit  int64 = 16 << 10
	DraftFinalizeBodyLimit int64 = 1 << 10
)

// DraftReplaceRequest is shared by the public Student and trusted Teacher
// transports so both invoke the same use case with an identical strict shape.
type DraftReplaceRequest struct {
	Schema                 string    `json:"schema"`
	ExpectedVersion        int64     `json:"expected_version"`
	DirectionCode          *string   `json:"direction_code"`
	SelfAssessedExperience *string   `json:"self_assessed_experience"`
	KnownStacks            *[]string `json:"known_stacks"`
	DesiredStacks          *[]string `json:"desired_stacks"`
	GoalCode               *string   `json:"goal_code"`
	GoalText               *string   `json:"goal_text"`
	PreferredLanguage      *string   `json:"preferred_language"`
	WeeklyMinutes          *int      `json:"weekly_minutes"`
	PreferredPace          *string   `json:"preferred_pace"`
}

func (request DraftReplaceRequest) UseCaseInput(studentID, requestID string) studentuc.PutStudentOnboardingDraftInput {
	return studentuc.PutStudentOnboardingDraftInput{
		Schema: request.Schema, StudentID: studentID, RequestID: requestID,
		ExpectedVersion: request.ExpectedVersion,
		StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers: domain.StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers{
			DirectionCode: request.DirectionCode, SelfAssessedExperience: request.SelfAssessedExperience,
			KnownStacks: request.KnownStacks, DesiredStacks: request.DesiredStacks,
			GoalCode: request.GoalCode, GoalText: request.GoalText,
			PreferredLanguage: request.PreferredLanguage, WeeklyMinutes: request.WeeklyMinutes,
			PreferredPace: request.PreferredPace,
		},
	}
}

type DraftFinalizeRequest struct {
	Schema                 string `json:"schema"`
	ExpectedDraftVersion   int64  `json:"expected_draft_version"`
	ExpectedProfileVersion int64  `json:"expected_profile_version"`
}

func (request DraftFinalizeRequest) UseCaseInput(studentID, requestID string) studentuc.FinalizeStudentOnboardingDraftInput {
	return studentuc.FinalizeStudentOnboardingDraftInput{
		Schema: request.Schema, StudentID: studentID, RequestID: requestID,
		ExpectedDraftVersion: request.ExpectedDraftVersion, ExpectedProfileVersion: request.ExpectedProfileVersion,
	}
}

func DecodeJSON(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, limit int64, target any) error {
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, limit))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(target); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		return errors.New("request body must contain one JSON value")
	}
	return nil
}

func WriteError(w http.ResponseWriter, err error) {
	switch {
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation):
		http.Error(w, "invalid onboarding draft request", http.StatusBadRequest)
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict):
		http.Error(w, "onboarding draft version or idempotency conflict", http.StatusConflict)
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound):
		http.Error(w, "onboarding draft not found", http.StatusNotFound)
	default:
		http.Error(w, "onboarding draft operation failed", http.StatusInternalServerError)
	}
}
